recorded.prompt:q-second-gateway:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-gateway:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-second-gateway:b: 12.1: mapping pair by pair is the approach the internal format replaces.
recorded.prompt:q-second-gateway:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-gateway:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-second-gateway:c: 12.1: the record holds full values and each destination maps out of it, so the inbound mappings stay as they are.
recorded.prompt:q-second-gateway:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-gateway:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-second-gateway:d: 12.1: packagers and channels only move bytes; the integration work is in the mappings.
recorded.prompt:q-unlisted-status:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unlisted-status:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unlisted-status:a: 12.4: a value the table lacks is refused, never guessed; answering 00 guesses an approval.
recorded.prompt:q-unlisted-status:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unlisted-status:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unlisted-status:b: 12.4: the rule is 96 with a cancellation, because the unknown status may have been an approval.
recorded.prompt:q-unlisted-status:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unlisted-status:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unlisted-status:d: 12.4: the cancellation at the gateway is part of the rule, so 96 without it leaves a possible charge in place.
recorded.prompt:q-post-times-out:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-post-times-out:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-post-times-out:b: 12.5: a new key is a new payment, and a retry under another key is a second purchase (ticket 4).
recorded.prompt:q-post-times-out:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-post-times-out:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-post-times-out:c: 12.5: after a timeout the caller can't tell whether the payment happened.
recorded.prompt:q-post-times-out:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-post-times-out:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-post-times-out:d: 12.5 and 12.7: the moves after a timeout are the same-key retry or a cancel; a refund is a separate transaction with a new key.
recorded.prompt:q-try-again:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-try-again:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-try-again:b: 12.5 (3): the gateway stores the failure under the key, and a retry gets it, not a second 0200.
recorded.prompt:q-try-again:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-try-again:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-try-again:c: 12.5: the gateway never resends the 0200, and here it reversed the purchase.
recorded.prompt:q-try-again:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-try-again:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
